folds.heading: ## Later activity authority and long-play clarification, 2026-11-04 (B61)
folds.body: AD52/ACR1–ACR14 now adopts the reusable activity principles; A1’s exact investigation envelope, examples, numbers and implementation shape remain proposals. USER_VISION’s later long-play clarification and ACR1 explicitly preserve long growth, sustained pursuits and time enjoyed in a place: compressing repetitive handling and delivering a small slice do not require short campaigns, world stays or rapid mastery. This adds no target duration or compulsory slow grind and does not validate E1–E5 effort estimates. Keep AD51’s shared-software seam separate from compressed player activity, and preserve actual costs, consequences, clocks, knowledge and world differences.
